static_traits.name: Chen Jin
static_traits.family_status: Living with husband in a rural area
static_traits.social_status: Has several friends for daily conversation, but has not yet discussed negative thinking with them; relationship with husband strained due to negative thinking and reactions
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychological problems or treatment history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent thinking, able to self-Reflect and cooperate, emotional experiences can be identified and expressed, neutral tone slightly tinged with Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: Tending to ignore the positive, focus on the negative, and generalize individual things not going as wished into overall failure; e.g., when cooking dinner for her husband, if one dessert does not suit his taste, the whole meal is rated a 'disaster'. This pattern became more prominent after Retired, causing Anxiety and avoidance toward cooking and various activities.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I want to find a way to stop these negative thoughts from occupying the joy of life; I hope to improve my mood and my relationship with my husband.'
growth_experiences: A negative thinking pattern that gradually emerged and reinforced in recent years: ignoring the positive in events, focusing on the negative and labeling it overall failure; after Retired, hoping to spend more time with her husband and feeling the need to excel in all aspects of life, this pattern became more pronounced. This led to Fear of failure, anxiety and avoidance in cooking and social activities, affecting mood and relationship satisfaction.

core_beliefs: Only by excelling in all aspects do I have value / deserve recognition
Once I make a mistake, I am a failure

special_situations.event: Prepared a dinner for her husband; he liked most dishes, but the dessert did not suit his taste
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If something goes wrong in one part, it means the whole thing failed, proving I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids cooking again; over-focuses on their own mistakes; tries to suppress disappointment with 'think of the positive side' but with limited effect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The whole dinner was a disaster; I failed again

special_situations.event: When interacting with her husband, he has not yet explicitly praised a certain detail (flat reaction/Silence)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he has not explicitly praised, it means he does not like it, meaning I did not do well
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly focusing on others' subtle reactions and judging oneself accordingly; reducing attempts to avoid being negated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Him not speaking means not liking it; I did not do well enough

special_situations.event: Before attending or preparing for social activities, worries in advance about possible small mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as one part goes wrong, it will ruin the whole event and be negated by others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Anxiety in advance, avoiding participating in activities to avoid failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: As long as one thing goes not smoothly, the whole event is ruined

special_situations.event: Having more time after Retired to repeatedly ruminate on daily interactions and details
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot excel everywhere in the new life, it means I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly recalling negative details, ignoring positive feedback to force self-improvement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I still have not done well enough; I do not deserve to enjoy Retired life

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized by and close to a significant other (the husband), obtaining affirmation and a sense of value in daily life
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure being negated, being criticized or disappointing the other, thus damaging the relationship
defense_goal: Avoiding being negated by pursuing perfection
Reducing Anxiety and self-blame by avoiding activities that might fail

object_relations.self_representation: A perfection-demanding self, fearing failure, 'not good enough'
object_relations.object_representation: Potential judges (Silence or flat reactions interpreted as negation)

manifestations: After Retired, role and time-structure changes, trying to maintain a sense of worth by 'excelling in all aspects'
Once a small mistake occurs, negating the whole experience, subjectively feeling efforts 'have no meaning'
outcomes: Decreased enjoyment of activities and socializing

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes 'must perform excellently in every aspect' as a rigid standard, demanding of self
Evaluating a meal's success or failure by all-or-nothing standards
Internalizes others' feedback (such as whether the husband praises) as the core basis for measuring self-worth

positive_force: Willing to seek professional help and actively cooperate, willing to try behavioral experiments
Able to identify and express one's own automatic thoughts and emotional experiences
Has a certain degree of social support (a few friends to talk with)
There are positive moments in interactions with the husband (such as most dishes being recognized)
negative_force: Evident perfectionism and all-or-nothing thinking tendencies
Negating the positive and mental filtering, over-focusing on negative details
Mind reading of others' reactions and dependence on external approval
Intense fear of failure leading to Avoids cooking and activities
Excessive rumination and self-evaluation triggered by increased time after Retired

target_behavior.behavior: Anxiety and avoidance in cooking and daily activities
antecedent: Before preparing to cook or do activities, worries about possible small mistakes
Receiving or perceiving a bit of negative feedback after completion (e.g., dessert not suiting taste)
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of failure and being negated, plus all-or-nothing thinking and overgeneralization, leading to equating individual mistakes with overall failure
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential failure and negative evaluation, to temporarily reduce Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced participation in beloved activities, Decreased enjoyment of life; Relationship tension with husband

target_behavior.behavior: Labeling individual things not going as wished as 'overall failure/disaster' (verbal or inner self-evaluation)
antecedent: A certain part not yet reaching Anticipation or the other's flat reaction/Silence
Self-review and rumination after socializing or interacting with the husband
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized high standards and external-validation orientation, accompanied by negating the positive and mental filtering
target_behavior.function: Preventing future mistakes through harsh self-evaluation and a sense of control (superficial Self-protection)
target_behavior.consequence: Increased Low mood and Sense of frustration, further intensifying Anxiety and avoidance
